title: Programmatic Advertising for Multi-Location Businesses: How to Scale Without Losing Local Impact

facts.fact: Third-party research cited by the page says consistent branding can increase revenue by up to 20 per cent.
facts.quote: Research shows that consistent branding can increase revenue by up to 20 per cent.

facts.fact: The vendor defines programmatic advertising as the fully automated, data-driven, real-time buying and selling of digital ad space across multiple websites and networks using AI and real-time bidding.
facts.quote: Programmatic advertising is the fully automated, data-driven, real-time buying and selling of digital ad space across multiple websites and networks using artificial intelligence (AI) and real-time bidding.

facts.fact: The vendor lists GPS and IP address targeting, geofencing, and beacon technology as location targeting methods for local programmatic advertising.
facts.quote: Local programmatic advertising uses many location targeting methods, including GPS and IP address targeting, geofencing and beacon technology.

facts.fact: The vendor states that local programmatic platforms can add targeting criteria such as demographics and weather conditions.
facts.quote: Local programmatic platforms also allow brands to include additional targeting criteria, such as demographics and weather conditions.

facts.fact: The vendor says centralized programmatic reporting can cover impressions, clicks, conversions, foot traffic and revenue attribution from all locations.
facts.quote: centralized reporting, and detailed analytics and metrics – such as impressions, clicks, conversions, foot traffic and revenue attribution – from all locations.

facts.fact: The vendor's article is dated April 22 with a 5-minute read time; the year is not shown on the page.
